title: Why Grass-Fed Matters: Q&A with an Organic Dairy Farmer -
summary: An organic grass-fed dairy farmer says organic food is healthier and more nutritious and that organic farms help the environment.

assertions.quote: It is healthier, it has more vitamins in it, more minerals in it
It produces a really healthy milk that's high in omega-3s and CLAs
They produce healthier food and they're better for the environment.
Organic farms sequester carbon and, in our grazing, we have a lot of diverse plants

verdicts.note: Organic soils often hold more carbon, but much of it comes from imported manure, and the net sequestration gain is debated.

Citing Gattinger et al. (2012), soil organic carbon is higher in organic fields because of manure, but the authors argue the extra land organic needs would likely make it net negative for carbon stocks at larger scales.
